craft_notes: Sthāyin: clear-joy. Close: water. Rejected: 'applause' — killed; 'holy water' — killed: water plain.

lines: Three claps first, sounded strong to clear all bar —
with topknot-count thrice-told, then sprinkle water.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tālatrayam purā dattvā saśabdaṃ vighnaśāntaye | śikhāsaṃkhyābhijaptena toyenābhyukṣayet tataḥ

reads_against.argmap: Three claps with sound against obstacles; topknot-count water then sprinkled.
c1_essence: Three claps sounded; topknot-count water sprinkled.
